login.phoneDescription: We will send a 6-digit code to your phone on WhatsApp.
login.otpDescription: Code sent to {phone}. Enter it to continue.

dashboard.loadErrorDescription: Please try again in a moment.
dashboard.referralCodeDescription: Your referral code is {code}. Share it with doctors and clinic owners to earn revenue-share on their first year of Docita.
dashboard.shareKitDescription: Copy the message, download the showcase PDF, or send a doctor the signup link.
dashboard.bankingSubmittedNotVerified: Submitted but not yet verified. We pay you once we confirm.
dashboard.bankingAddDescription: Add your bank account so we can pay your revenue share.

banking.title: Banking details
banking.description: We pay you via bank transfer (NEFT / RTGS / UPI). The account holder name must match the name on your PAN.
banking.verifiedDescription: Verified. Editing will require a fresh review.
banking.unverifiedDescription: Submitted but not yet verified. You can still edit until we approve.
banking.formDescription: Saved values are encrypted at rest. We display only the last 4 digits of the account number.
banking.errorIfsc: IFSC must look like AAAA0XXXXXX (11 chars).
banking.successSaved: Bank details saved. We'll review and verify before the next payout.
banking.errorSaveFallback: We could not save your details. Try again.

payouts.title: Payouts
payouts.description: Revenue-share payouts from your referred clinics' first-year billing. Manual disbursement via bank transfer.
payouts.empty: No payouts yet. They'll appear here once your referred clinics start paying.

referrals.title: Referrals
referrals.description: Clinics that signed up using your code. 'Active (paying)' means their first paid invoice cleared.
referrals.empty: No referrals yet. Share your code from the Share kit page to get started.

share.title: Share kit
share.description: Copy a message, download the showcase PDF, or send a doctor your signup link.
share.signupLinkDescription: Send this to any doctor or clinic owner. The link applies your referral code automatically.
share.whatsappDescription: Pre-filled with your name and code. Copy and paste into a chat.
share.pdfDescription: A one-page PDF explaining Docita to a doctor. Hand it out or attach it to your message.
